STOCKHOLM , October 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- BioArctic AB (publ) (Nasdaq Stockholm: BIOA B) today announced the composition of its Nomination Committee for the 2027 Annual General Meeting.
The Nomination Committee has been appointed in accordance with the principles adopted by the Annual General Meeting and consists of representatives of the three largest shareholders by voting rights as of September 30, 2026, as well as the Chair of the Board (convener).

As of September 30, 2026, the shareholders represented on the Nomination Committee together hold approximately 57 percent of the shares and 82 percent of the votes in the Company.
The instruction for the Nomination Committee is available on BioArctic's website www.bioarctic.com/en/governance/nomination-committee/
The Nomination Committee's proposals will be presented in the notice to the Annual General Meeting 2027, as well as on the company's website, www.bioarctic.com
Shareholders wishing to submit proposals to the Nomination Committee may do so by e-mail to [email protected] (please mark the e-mail "Nomination Committee") or by post to BioArctic AB, Att: Nomination Committee, Warfvinges vÃ¤g 35, SE-112 51 Stockholm, Sweden. To ensure that submitted proposals can be considered by the Nomination Committee, they should be received no later than January 15, 2027.
BioArctic's Annual General Meeting 2027 will be held on Thursday, May 27, 2027, at 4.30 pm CEST in Stockholm. A request to have a matter considered at the meeting must be received no later than April 15, 2027, for the matter to be included in the notice.
The information was released for public disclosure, through the agency of the contact person below, on October 30, 2026, at 3 pm CET.
